about_the_game:
Monstabox is a brand-new, turn-based 1v1 battle game that blends strategy with the excitement of action-packed combat.

Choose your favorite monster and a set of spells, then roll your Monstabox across the board to attack, set up combos, and unleash your monster’s ultimate moves to dominate the battlefield!

With fast-paced 3-minute battles, intense back-and-forth action, and thrilling comebacks, every match is a heart-pounding experience. Win or lose, you’ll always want to tweak your strategy and play again—this is gameplay like never before!

Play anywhere on PC, smartphone, or tablet with cross-platform and cross-progression support. Take on online battles to compete worldwide and become the ultimate champion!

Wait, wait! The match isn’t over yet!
Defeating your opponent isn’t enough—Monstabox doesn’t end there! When you KO your opponent, a Star appears on the board. The player who activates the face of their Monstabox with the Star wins the match!

Key Features:

✔ Unique battle system

✔ Strategic depth without overwhelming complexity

✔ Fast-paced, no downtime gameplay 

✔ Extra Game modes crafted for E-sports & competitive communities

✔ Distinct visual appeal & broad audience reach

✔ Toy-like box and board game fee

Recommended for Players Who…

✔ Love competitive and strategy games: Enjoy fast-paced battles and skill-based tactics.

✔ Enjoy deck-building games: Want to explore an intuitive and unique new system.

✔ Like casual & party games: Want a game that’s easy to pick up, fun in short sessions, but deep enough to master.

✔ Are between 14 and 40 years old: A perfect balance of strategy and accessibility for all types of players!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1Gb Video Memory, capable of OpenGL 3.0+ support (2.1 with ARB extensions acceptable)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
